patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with dark backgrounds dominate the page, creating an immersive, cinematic feel, often with content centered or arranged in balanced grids.
Large, clean sans-serif headings are used for section titles, with the main hero heading featuring a subtle blue-to-purple gradient text effect.
A high-contrast dark theme is consistently applied, using black or very dark grey for backgrounds and white or light grey for primary text, with subtle gradients for key accents.

Sections and individual content cards reveal themselves with a fade-in and slight slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling. The hero background features a subtle parallax effect, and the header navigation transforms from transparent to a solid dark background after initial scroll.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, often introduced by a large heading and followed by a grid of feature cards or descriptive text, maintaining a consistent visual rhythm.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-bleed video background with abstract figures, overlaid with a dark gradient to ensure text readability, and features a large, gradient-filled heading and a prominent call-to-action button.

Scroll-triggered animations are used extensively to reveal content. As the user scrolls, new sections and individual elements within them (like cards) fade into view and subtly slide upwards, creating a dynamic and engaging experience. This is consistent with an 'Animate On Scroll' (AOS) library.

The main navigation bar is sticky, initially appearing transparent over the hero content. Upon scrolling past the hero, it gains a solid, dark background to maintain contrast and visibility against subsequent page content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized hero heading (~4-5x body) with a gradient fill, followed by large, bold section headings (~2.5x body) and clear, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card corners, providing a soft, modern touch without being fully rounded or sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and balanced spacing within content grids, contributing to a premium and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's standout feature is its immersive, dark, and futuristic aesthetic, achieved through a full-bleed video hero, subtle gradient typography, and sophisticated scroll-triggered reveals. This creates a distinctive sense of depth and discovery, making the content feel like an unfolding experience rather than static information.
